401260201.text: Huh, looks like we're a few people short today...

401260202.text: Morning, friends. Xingqiu said he wants to take some time and focus on writing poems, so he'll join us later.

401260203.text: Noelle has other duties today, so she asked me to tell everyone not to wait up for her.

401260204.text: Aw, okay. Well, never mind... What about Callirhoe, though? She said she'd be here...

401260205.text: I got here really early, but I haven't seen her yet.

401260206.text: Are you talking about the girl with the blue hair? I saw her on the bridge near Dihua Marsh during my morning training.

401260207.text: She looked a little upset, so I didn't want to disturb her...

401260208.text: Upset? Oh no... What should we do? Was it something we said last night? Paimon's worried...

401260210.text: I agree! If she's run into some kind of trouble, I'd like to help her.

401260211.text: Huh? You're all going? Then I'm coming too!

401260212.text: Shall we start with the bridge? We're all here a little early, so there should be time.

401260213.text: Good idea. We'll be back in a jiffy!

401260301.text: Oh, so this is the place? We ran into her here yesterday, too!

401260302.text: She looked like something was weighing on her mind then as well.

401260303.text: It's also not far from where we were dropping those leaves...

401260305.text: Oh, right! We were so busy matching couplets, we forgot to mention...

401260306.text: You tell everyone about your inspiration walk yesterday...

401260308.text: I wonder... Could Miss Callirhoe have been the one who wrote that poem on the leaf?

401260309.text: Hmm? What makes you say that?

401260310.text: Oh, sorry, uh... nothing — well, nothing concrete. Just a hunch, I guess.

401260311.text: It's just... That poem on the leaf kinda gave me the same feeling as when I saw her yesterday. So much sadness...

401260312.text: Now that you mention it, this is upstream from where we found the poem...

401260314.text: Hey, look! Over there! Another leaf!

401260315.text: ...Wow, you're right! And this one has writing on it too!

401261101.text: Argh! Why does it have to float so quickly?

401261201.text: Can't you just fly over and grab it?

401261202.text: Um... But Paimon can't swim, what if Paimon accidentally falls into the water...

401261402.text: Are the words still legible? Or have they been washed out?

401261403.text: Looks like the ink's intact! Let Paimon take a look at what it says...

401261404.text: Huh? This is related to the poem we wrote in reply yesterday! She must've picked up one of our leaves!

401261406.text: Hmm, it's looking a lot like Callirhoe was the one who wrote this.

401261407.text: She seems to care a lot about that story, huh.

401261408.text: Actually, when Paimon first saw her, Paimon was wondering...

401261409.text: Do you think... is it possible that... she's a—

401261410.text: Let's just focus on finding her first.

401261411.text: Based on the current and accounting for wind strength... everyone, please follow me.

401261501.text: ...How are you holding up? Would you like some support, Miss Callirhoe?

401261502.text: You can also lean on Paimon if you need!

401260604.text: ...This is exactly what I saw the other day!

401260607.text: ...Huh? Why are you all looking at me like that?

401260610.text: Ah! How did this happen... Please wait a moment...

401260611.text: The water droplet turns back into Callirhoe's human form before everyone's eyes...

401260612.text: Oh no... Did I use up too much energy?

401260613.text: How did you... What's going on here? Miss Callirhoe, are you some kind of adeptus?

401260614.text: No... I'm so sorry for deceiving you all for so long. Actually, I'm... an Oceanid, who flowed here from Fontaine long ago...

401260616.text: Ah! The Grand Master has mentioned them before — the Oceanids were the familiars of the former Hydro Archon. They all fled Fontaine after the archon died, and settled across the world...

401260617.text: That's correct... Though, to tell you the truth, I can't even completely recall how I found myself here...

401260618.text: I have a vague impression of my ancestral home, but I can't recall clearly anything I saw on my journey...

401260619.text: All I know is that by the time I arrived in Mondstadt, I had lost most of my power, and couldn't even sustain a physical form...

401260620.text: Eventually, I settled in a place called Springvale, where I slowly began to regain my power...

401260621.text: Springvale is a serene and beautiful place. The water that flows through there is clear and pure, just like the hearts of the people who dwell there.

401260622.text: So you're the spring fairy of Springvale?

401260623.text: Yes, Diona, and I remember you too, you know! When you were little, you often came to the spring at night to speak with me.

401260624.text: Really? You're not messing with me, are ya?

401260625.text: (I... I always thought that was just a local legend...)

401260626.text: Your favorite little pillow, the fish one... Its name is "Bubbles," is it not?

401260628.text: (All those childhood memories... so they weren't just a dream!)

401260629.text: So... if this is true, then all those things written on the leaves...

401260703.text: ...It's nothing... I'm just scared that I won't be able to maintain this form much longer.

401260704.text: Okay, don't panic... Wait here, Callirhoe! I'll go fetch Grandpa Finch!

401260705.text: ...Take it slow, Diona.... Finch isn't a young man anymore, he's not as steady on his feet...

401260706.text: I can still... hold on... a bit longer...

401260707.text: Okay! Stay strong! You can do it!

401260802.text: Is that Diona? You're back early today.

401260803.text: Today's your special day, Grandpa Finch! Can you come with me?

401260804.text: Oh? Well, where are we going?

401260806.text: Haha, did you catch a nice little fishie?

401260807.text: Ugh, just come with me already! This is extremely important!

401260808.text: But, I promised your father that I'd go to...

401260810.text: Alright, alright... No need to get worked up, I'm right behind you...

401260811.text: That's more like it. Now, come on, I'll help you.

401260812.text: (Ohoho, Draff's daughter is just like him when she's on a mission...)

401260902.text: Over here, over here! It's okay, Grandpa Finch, take your time.

401260903.text: Hmm? What's all this? What are all these people doing here?

401260904.text: Even Mika's here? Haha, how's work been going lately?

401260905.text: And even some friends from abroad, if I'm not mistaken? ...You do know that today's not my birthday, don't you?

401260906.text: Greetings, Mr. Finch. My name is Chongyun. We all met at the poetry gala, and... Well, there's someone we'd like to introduce you to...

401260910.text: ...Oh, I remember, hahaha, I remember alright. How could I ever forget?

401260911.text: Although, your appearance is different than I recall. Back then, you looked like you'd stepped right out of a fairytale...

401260912.text: Oho, but I'm one to talk! Of course a fairy from a fairytale can change forms... In your eyes, I'm probably the one who's changed beyond all recognition...

401260913.text: Haha... Oh, even after all these years, you still know just what to say to make me laugh.

401260914.text: I thought you were only able to appear in the dead of night? ...There have been times when I've wondered whether it really was all a dream...

401260915.text: ...I'm sorry I kept you waiting for so long, Finch.

401260916.text: ...Oh, it can't have been that long... It's been but the blink of an eye, really.

401260917.text: ...Finch, would you like to hear a poem I wrote for you?

401260918.text: A poem? You write poetry now? Well of course! I'd be delighted to listen... I'll hang on every word that leaves your lips...

401260919.text: ...In that case, let me read you a story about the spring fairy...

401260921.text: Yes... This is how I remember you from when we first met...

401260922.text: All those years ago... It really has been a long old time, hasn't it?

401260924.text: It's okay, I understand. Your poem, it... it explains everything...

401260927.text: This is a droplet of water condensed from my own power.

401260928.text: ...Finch, I don't have a physical form like humans, and I can't stay by your side. I don't know how long it'll be before I can change back into human form again...

401260929.text: But as long as this droplet remains with you, our hearts will always be connected... no matter the distance between us.

401260930.text: I will always be one with the spring. From this day onwards, if you call me, I will meet you in your dreams.

401260934.text: Hahaha, you've really learned a lot, haven't you? And you don't even mind that the kids are watching...

401260936.text: How could it possibly? This is the happiest moment of my life...

401260937.text: I just worry that once I go to sleep, I won't ever want to wake up again...

401260939.text: Hahaha, I'm only joking! Ah, it seems that you still have much to learn.

401260941.text: (Hehe, Grandpa Finch and Callirhoe look so happy! What a purrfect moment...)

401260942.text: Diona, thank you for fetching Finch for me. I've never forgotten you either.

401260943.text: I used to chat with you a lot... Wasn't it ever annoying?

401260944.text: Of course not! You are one of the truest friends I have in the entire world.

401260945.text: That's why I gave you your gift. So that a part of me could always be with you.

401260947.text: (Wait... So is Diona's ability to mix delicious drinks from disgusting ingredients a blessing from this water spirit?)

401260948.text: (And if so... Is it also possible that my pure-yang spirit is a gift from some being?)

401260950.text: ...My physical form is about to disappear.

401260953.text: ...I've never regretted meeting you, or deciding to talk to you that night. Not once, all these long years, not for a single moment.

401260954.text: ...It probably goes without saying, but neither have I.

401260955.text: Although... it was different from in the stories... that fateful night, I never gave you that kiss...

401260956.text: This gift that represents my promise and my love, I give it to you now...

401260961.text: At moments like this, it's only polite to close your eyes...

401260964.text: What? But... Paimon didn't get a chance to say goodbye.

401260966.text: Don't worry now, she hasn't gone far...

401260967.text: Just like she said, she'll always be one with the spring... by our side, and in our dreams...

401261001.text: Oh? Hey, you're all back! And it looks like you're in much better spirits than before.

401261002.text: Hu Tao's a step ahead. She's already talking about printing a poetry anthology.

401261003.text: She said she "can't wait for everyone's final words, because I'm itching to pull the trigger." By which, I assume she meant she eagerly anticipates receiving everyone's freestyle poetry submissions to help her close the deal.

401261004.text: Where have you all been? I've been waiting here forever!

401261005.text: Perhaps they lacked sufficient inspiration, and wished to have an emergency communion with nature? And with any luck, I'll bet they heard some fine poetry along the way...?

401261006.text: Tone-Deaf Bard! Does this mean that right from the start, you—

401261009.text: Oh! Uh... Right from the start, you said you would treat us to a nice meal.

401261011.text: I think this is worth a meal.

401261012.text: #Haha, very well! Since {NICKNAME} agrees, then it looks like I can't escape this time.

401261013.text: Diona, dear Diona... Could I trouble you to fix us a couple of your delicious beverages?

401261014.text: Hmph! You wish! ...Alright, well normally I'd never agree, but... Since I happen to be in a good mood today...

401261015.text: Huh? So just what have you guys been up to all this time? Why does it feel like there are some unspoken words hanging in the air here that everyone is privy to but myself...

401261016.text: Really? Must be the breeze, you're reading way too much into it.

401261017.text: Y—Yeah! That's right, we're just, uh... taking a walk. Inspiration walk. Since it worked so well last time.

401261018.text: Oh, so even Mika's in on it...

401261019.text: Chongyun, how about you tell me what happened on the sly? I've just remembered that I heard about a haunted house recently that you'll definitely want to check out!

401261020.text: I'm willing to bet that even your pure-yang spirit won't be able to scare off these demons!

401261021.text: I appreciate the gesture, but no thanks. Not this time.

401261022.text: And I'm starting to think that... maybe this pure-yang spirit isn't such a bad thing after all...

401261023.text: Huh? What the... What's gotten into you!?

401261024.text: Okay, that confirms it! I call shenanigans, something big definitely went down here!

401261901.text: Oh, child, let me stay here a little longer...

401269903.text: This should be far enough upstream. Let's split up and search the area.

401269905.text: Ah! She's surrounded by hilichurls! Let's go save her!
